// Referência do benchmark.
import { WATER, isSolid } from './blocks.js'
import { getBlockAt } from './world.js'

export const PLAYER_WIDTH = 0.6
export const PLAYER_HEIGHT = 1.8
export const EYE_HEIGHT = 1.62
export const GRAVITY = 32
export const JUMP_VELOCITY = 9
export const WALK_SPEED = 4.3
export const SPRINT_SPEED = 5.6
export const SNEAK_SPEED = 1.3
export const TERMINAL_VELOCITY = 78

const HALF = PLAYER_WIDTH / 2
const EPS = 1e-7

export function createPlayer(position) {
  return { position: [...position], velocity: [0, 0, 0], onGround: false, yaw: 0, pitch: 0, flying: false }
}

function anyBlock(world, pos, test) {
  const x0 = Math.floor(pos[0] - HALF), x1 = Math.ceil(pos[0] + HALF) - 1
  const y0 = Math.floor(pos[1]), y1 = Math.ceil(pos[1] + PLAYER_HEIGHT) - 1
  const z0 = Math.floor(pos[2] - HALF), z1 = Math.ceil(pos[2] + HALF) - 1
  for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++) for (let z = z0; z <= z1; z++) {
    if (test(getBlockAt(world, x, y, z))) return true
  }
  return false
}

export const collidesAt = (world, position) => anyBlock(world, position, isSolid)

export function canPlaceBlock(player, x, y, z) {
  const [px, py, pz] = player.position
  const overlap = (a0, a1, b0, b1) => a0 < b1 && b0 < a1
  return !(overlap(px - HALF, px + HALF, x, x + 1) && overlap(py, py + PLAYER_HEIGHT, y, y + 1) && overlap(pz - HALF, pz + HALF, z, z + 1))
}

// Move num eixo em passos curtos; devolve true se bateu.
function moveAxis(world, pos, axis, delta) {
  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.abs(delta) / 0.25))
  for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {
    const next = [...pos]
    next[axis] += delta / steps
    if (!collidesAt(world, next)) { pos[axis] = next[axis]; continue }
    if (axis === 1) pos[1] = delta < 0 ? Math.floor(next[1]) + 1 : Math.floor(next[1] + PLAYER_HEIGHT) - PLAYER_HEIGHT
    else pos[axis] = delta > 0 ? Math.floor(next[axis] + HALF) - HALF - EPS : Math.floor(next[axis] - HALF) + 1 + HALF + EPS
    return true
  }
  return false
}

const supported = (world, pos) => collidesAt(world, [pos[0], pos[1] - 0.05, pos[2]])

function substep(p, input, dt, world) {
  const sin = Math.sin(p.yaw), cos = Math.cos(p.yaw)
  const f = (input.forward ? 1 : 0) - (input.backward ? 1 : 0)
  const r = (input.right ? 1 : 0) - (input.left ? 1 : 0)
  let mx = -sin * f + cos * r, mz = -cos * f - sin * r
  const len = Math.hypot(mx, mz)
  if (len > 0) { mx /= len; mz /= len }
  const speed = input.sneak && !p.flying ? SNEAK_SPEED : input.sprint && input.forward ? SPRINT_SPEED : WALK_SPEED
  p.velocity[0] = mx * speed
  p.velocity[2] = mz * speed
  const inWater = anyBlock(world, p.position, id => id === WATER)
  if (p.flying) p.velocity[1] = (input.jump ? WALK_SPEED : 0) - (input.sneak ? WALK_SPEED : 0)
  else if (inWater) {
    p.velocity[1] -= (GRAVITY / 4) * dt
    if (input.jump) p.velocity[1] = 3
    p.velocity[1] = Math.max(p.velocity[1], -3)
  } else {
    if (input.jump && p.onGround) p.velocity[1] = JUMP_VELOCITY
    p.velocity[1] = Math.max(p.velocity[1] - GRAVITY * dt, -TERMINAL_VELOCITY)
  }
  const wasGround = p.onGround
  const hitY = moveAxis(world, p.position, 1, p.velocity[1] * dt)
  p.onGround = hitY && p.velocity[1] < 0
  if (hitY) p.velocity[1] = 0
  const edgeGuard = input.sneak && !p.flying && (p.onGround || wasGround)
  for (const axis of [0, 2]) {
    const before = p.position[axis]
    moveAxis(world, p.position, axis, p.velocity[axis] * dt)
    if (edgeGuard && !supported(world, p.position)) p.position[axis] = before
  }
}

export function stepPlayer(player, input, dt, world) {
  const p = { ...player, position: [...player.position], velocity: [...player.velocity] }
  const n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(dt / 0.05 - 1e-9))
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) substep(p, input, dt / n, world)
  return p
}
